name: Share Price & Volume
summary: Daily share price line over a volume panel with moving averages, 52-week high / low, VWAP, event pins, current-price tag and a shared zoom.
summary_zh: 日度股价折线 + 成交量副图：移动均线、52 周高低点、VWAP、事件编号标注、最新价标签，两图共享缩放。
description_zh: 投行“股价表现”页的标准图：上方为收盘价走势（可带浅色面积），下方为成交量柱，两个面板共用横轴与缩放（滚轮、拖动滑块或右上角 1M/3M/6M/YTD/1Y/All 快捷区间），纵轴随可见区间自动重算。可叠加 50/200 日均线、滚动 VWAP、52 周最高/最低价线（或区间底纹）、要约价等参考线；绑定 price_events 后在价格线上显示编号事件，悬停查看说明。十字准星提示框给出日期、收盘价、单日涨跌、区间涨跌、成交量与均线值。数据为每个交易日一行（date、close、volume，可选 high/low）。
best_for: Share price history and trading context for a target
Unaffected price / premium discussions with an offer reference line
Event-driven price commentary (results, M&A rumours, guidance)
avoid_when: Comparing several stocks (use line with rebase: 100)

volume.desc: Traded volume (shares); omit to hide the volume panel

high.desc: Daily high (52-week high, VWAP typical price)

low.desc: Daily low (52-week low, VWAP typical price)

area.desc: Light fill under the price line

ma.desc: Simple moving averages in trading days; [] for none

vwap.desc: Rolling VWAP line: true (20-day) or a number of days

lastPrice.desc: Current price tag on the right axis with a dotted guide

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color}] horizontal price lines (offer, unaffected price)

eventsData.desc: Dataset id of events (date, label, kind, detail) drawn as numbered pins

eventsEncode.desc: Field mapping of the events dataset

rangeSelector.desc: Quick range buttons (top-right); true or a subset such as ['3m','1y','all']

volumeShare.desc: Share of the plot height used by the volume panel (0.1–0.5)

format.desc: Price format (defaults to the close field format)

volumeFormat.desc: Volume format in the tooltip (defaults to the volume field format)

zoom.desc: Wheel / pinch and slider zoom shared by both panels; value axes re-fit to the window

interactions: Crosshair tooltip: date, close, 1-day and period change, volume, MAs
Hover near a pin to read the event
Wheel / pinch / slider zoom shared by price and volume
